Sr. Analyst \- Process Analytics \- SCM**Ready to turn bold ideas into real\-world impact?**  

 At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change, we lead it. AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises.  

 Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**


1\. Analyze supply chain data to identify trends and areas for improvement; 2\. Develop and implement strategies to optimize supply chain operations; 3\. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to streamline processes and enhance supply chain performance; 4\. Monitor inventory levels and ensure timely replenishment to meet demand; 5\. Evaluate supplier performance and negotiate contracts to drive cost savings and improve quality; 6\. Identify risks in the supply chain and develop mitigation plans to ensure continuity of operations.**Qualifications**
